entities.summary: Jeffrey Curtis Ayres, formerly known as Jeff Pendergraph, is an American professional basketball player for Indomables de Ciudad Juárez of the Liga de Básquetbol Estatal de Chihuahua. He attended Etiwanda High School in Rancho Cucamonga, California and played college basketball for the Arizona State Sun Devils.
